description: This file is a shell script used for testing and scripting in a Git project, specifically focusing on commit operations, trailers, message cleanup, and other Git behaviors.

methods.name: commit_msg_is
methods.description: Checks if the latest git log message matches the expected message.

methods.name: check_summary_oneline
methods.description: Verifies the output of a git commit summary with specific prefix and postfix.

methods.name: trailer_commit_base
methods.description: Creates a commit with specific trailers for testing.

methods.name: output_tests_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up the test environment by checking out the main branch and removing test files.

methods.name: try_commit
methods.description: Performs a test commit with optional template and checks for specific content.

methods.name: try_commit_status_combo
methods.description: Runs a series of tests with different commit options and configurations.
